svg.title: From one run to twelve scenes: the small ones earn the big ones
svg.desc: On the left, what has run: one teacher run and one learner run, with a model in both chairs, and two evals built but not run. Across the span, the legwork: identifiers and schemas at scale, a registry at scale, reuse across languages, the five-minute bundle, certification, the constraint fields made live, privacy at scale. On the right, the twelve experiments we can already picture, ending at five minutes to master's.
